content.title: Luka Dončić Calls Off Engagement to Fiancée Anamaria Goltes as They Battle for Custody of Daughters
content.text: Dončić confirmed the separation in a statement provided to ESPN, just three months after the couple welcomed their second baby Updated on March 11, 2026 11:25AM EDT Luka Doncic and Anamaria Goltes. Credit : Anamaria Goltes/Instagram NEED TO KNOW Los Angeles Lakers star Luka Dončić and his fiancée Anamaria Goltes have called off their engagement, Dončić told ESPN in a statement"I love my daughters more than anything and I've been doing everything I can for them to be with me in the U.S. during the season, but that hasn't been possible, so I recently made the tough decision to end my engagement," Doncic told the outletGoltes has filed a petition seeking child support, according to reports NBA star Luka Dončić and Anamaria Goltes have called off their engagement. Just three months after Dončić, 27, and Goltes, 28, welcomed their second baby together, Dončić told ESPN on Tuesday, March 10, that he "recently made the tough decision to end my engagement." "I love my daughters more than anything and I've been doing everything I can for them to be with me in the U.S. during the season, but that hasn't been possible, so I recently made the tough decision to end my engagement," Dončić told the outlet. "Everything I do is for my daughters' happiness and I will always fight to be with them and give them the best life I can." Prior to Dončić's announcement, Goltes filed a petition seeking child support in a California court, according to documents reviewed by PEOPLE. In the petition, Goltes seeks attorney's fees and an unspecified sum in child support. Luka Dončić and Anamaria Goltes in 2023. Anamaria Goltes Instagram The Los Angeles Lakers star, who was traded from the Dallas Mavericks in a blockbuster trade in February 2025, proposed to Goltes in July 2023 near Bled Castle in Slovenia, where they're both from. The former couple met when they were just children. "We met when we were 12 years old at the seaside in Croatia," Goltes said in a 2020 Instagram Q&A, via the New York Post. "Fun fact: We still have the same group of friends we had at that time. You keep the real ones, am I right?" In December 2025, Dončić missed multiple Lakers games to be by Goltes' side as she gave birth to their second child. The former couple also share a two-year-old daughter, Gabriela, who was born in December 2023. Luka Doncic and Anamaria Goltes. Anamaria Goltes Instagram After the birth of his first child, Dončić told reporters, "First of all, it was the happiest day of my life," adding that Gabriela is a "great baby.” Related Stories After the shocking trade that sent Dončić to Los Angeles, PEOPLE spoke to the basketball star, who said he enjoys the Southern California weather and the ocean. When speaking about fatherhood, he said it's "the greatest thing in the world." Goltes often attended her fiancé's basketball games during their relationship, even giving fans a look at Gabriela watching her dad at an NBA game in May 2024.
